tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: The patient shows elevated creatinine and markedly increased total bilirubin, suggesting possible renal dysfunction and significant hyperbilirubinemia. Liver enzymes are within normal limits, making acute hepatocellular injury less likely. Other parameters, including electrolytes and proteins, are normal. Further evaluation of renal and hepatobiliary function is recommended.
